theorems.name: Submission.closedBall_rpow_kernel_lintegral_le_of_growth
theorems.statement: ∀ {X : Type} [NormedAddCommGroup X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (n : ℕ) (y : X) (ρ K : ℝ), 0 < n → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → μ (closedBall y s) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ n)) → ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ ρ → ∫⁻ x in closedBall y s, ENNReal.ofReal (‖x - y‖ ^ (1 - (n : ℝ))) ∂μ ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (n * K * s)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
